assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent dizziness, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology.
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for intermittent conduction abnormalities or atrial fibrillation.
The provided diagnosis codes are R55, G45.9, and R42.
The diagnosis codes support medical necessity for CPT 93247.
CPT 93247 is the service code in question.
